chapter: New York dance halls and one-nighters
title: Gilda Gray and the shimmy at the Follies Bergere
summary: Gilda Gray danced the shimmy with the band for about two weeks as a showcase, put there by the owners, before landing a big part in the Ziegfeld Follies.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So now back to Gilda Gray and her shimmy.

Well Gilda Gray did the shimmy and I think she stayed there about maybe two weeks. They put her in there as a sort of showcase so she could get a job in one of the big shows. Well I'll tell you who Gilda Gray was. It was the wife of Gil Bogue. Gil Bogue, Jimmy Thompson and Mr. Salvin owned this Follies Bragé at the top of the Winter Garden. They were the owners of it. Sam Salvin operated as a manager of it. But these other men were the partners. And they only brought Gilda Gray in there to do that dance with us for a showcase. And right after that she got a big part of the Zip Field Follies.
